### Nerdy to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 9, 2026


October 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/118732467/files/doc_news/Nerdy-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-on-November-9-2026-2026.pdf)


ST. LOUIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Nerdy Inc. (NYSE: NRDY), a leading platform for delivering live online learning, today announced the Company will release its third quarter financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, after the U.S. stock market closes on Monday, November 9, 2026. Following the release, Nerdy management will host a conference call and webcast at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss the Company’s financial and operating results.


Interested parties in the U.S. may listen to the call by dialing 1-833-461-5787. International callers can dial 1-585-542-9983. The Access Code is 345749738. A live webcast of the call will also be available on Nerdy’s investor relations website at[https://www.nerdy.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54627433&newsitemid=20261022801859&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com%2Finvestors&index=1&md5=7cf7120b4dc649a76f7c7586b12e63d6) .


**About Nerdy Inc.**


Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) operates a next-generation live tutoring and intervention platform that leverages the power of human expertise with advanced artificial intelligence (“AI”) to personalize learning, accelerate student achievement, and empower educators. Our mission is to transform the way people learn through technology. The Company’s purpose-built proprietary platform leverages technology, including AI, to connect learners of all ages to experts, delivering superior value on both sides of the network. Nerdy’s comprehensive learning destination provides learning experiences across thousands of subjects and multiple formats—including Learning Memberships, one-on-one instruction, small group tutoring, large format classes, and adaptive assessments. Nerdy’s flagship business, Varsity Tutors, is one of the nation’s largest platforms for live online tutoring and classes. Its solutions are available directly to students and consumers, as well as through certain institutions. Learn more about Nerdy at[https://www.nerdy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com&esheet=54627433&newsitemid=20261022801859&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nerdy.com&index=2&md5=7536d3710c7abf97d3e9c0580e37749a) .
